findings.architecture_correction: stable logical identity plus network acknowledgement is required only for a failure-atomic in-place refresh, not for best-effort fresh-token page recreation
findings.confirmed_regression: at the display cap, Search Again emits requests but the first response retires the unchanged token before adding a row
findings.preferred_next_direction: fresh-token page replacement with explicit page-state, wishlist, plugin, tab-order, and undo semantics
findings.same_token_clear: restores capacity but cannot distinguish delayed responses from the prior request lifetime
findings.waste_boundary: repeated clicks can multiply local buddy/user fan-out while display capacity remains zero; remote processing impact was not measured

source.scope: executable tests use bundled proxy; current public-flow review is separate
